prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.6%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Interactive Pet Preview & Redesign', 'Cloud Backup Account Reassurance', 'Account Pet Sync Guarantee Callout', 'Story Scroll Path Selection Layout', 'Existing Pet Account Sync Callout', 'Path Reassurance Story Copy', 'Adoption Pet Photo Diagnostics Split Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Interactive Desktop Onboarding Stage', 'Deferred Sign-in After Adoption', 'Real-time Waiting Progress & Taskbar Tips', 'Interactive Pet Styling Flow', 'Desktop Display Diagnostic Hint', 'Desktop Tray Notification Prompt', 'Path Selection Card Grid', 'Desktop Control Quick Guide Screen', 'Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Mini-Game', 'Pet Style Preview Gallery Screen', 'Pet Creation Progress Tracker', 'Path Guidance Hint on Story Screen', 'Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub', 'Account Pet Recovery Safety Guarantee', 'Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification', 'Desktop Rendering Verification Flow', 'Two-Column Path Choice Layout', 'Adoption Guarantee Copy Refresh', 'Desktop Spawn Sound Alert', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen', 'Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint', 'Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout', 'Generation Time Estimate & Progress Tracker', 'Story First Auth Reordering', 'Desktop Background Ready Chime Prompt', 'Custom Pet Creation Photo Diagnostic Screen', 'Desktop Display Compatibility Hint', 'Desktop Rendering Verification Status', 'Account Pet Sync & Recovery Hint', 'Photo Generation Quality Check Screen', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Mascot Walkthrough', 'Desktop Rendering Stage Status Counter', 'Multi-Stage Taskbar Setup Flow', 'Desktop Quick Controls Onboarding Screen', 'Account Recovery Safety Notice Hint', 'Compact Photo Upload Drop Zone Layout', 'Centered Path Selection Hub Layout', 'Pre-Home Desktop Visibility Check Screen', 'Story Screen Path Teaser & Quick Jump', 'Sign-in Recovery Guarantee Notice']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Spotlight Adoption Certificate Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a spotlight layout with high-contrast official registration badges.
candidates.why: Adoption completion drops to 69.4% with a high median duration of 89s; a focused spotlight layout emphasizes official pet registration momentum.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your desktop companion is officially registered and ready to join your workspace.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Sanctuary Arrival Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new arrival staging screen 'new_desktop_sanctuary' immediately after the waiting screen to celebrate pet rendering completion.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), making an explicit arrival celebration crucial before entering home intro.

new_desktop_sanctuary.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary
new_desktop_sanctuary.body: Your pet has officially arrived and is settling onto your desktop environment.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Control Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a two-screen walkthrough flow (new_control_overview and new_command_sheet) teaching users key pet controls and commands.
candidates.why: Three support emails noted confusion after onboarding on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.

home_intro.hint: Next up: learn how to interact with your pet!

new_control_overview.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_control_overview.body: Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open settings, hide the pet, or start a chat session.

new_command_sheet.headline: Pet Chat & Quick Actions
new_command_sheet.body: Use desktop shortcuts or chat prompts to trigger pet animations and mini-interactions.

candidates.title: Story Path Choice Flip Reordering
candidates.change: Reorder the initial flow so users choose their pet creation path on choose_path before reading the story screen.
candidates.why: choose_path currently takes a mean of 514s; presenting path choice upfront gives immediate focus before story context.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Companion Journey
choose_path.hint: Select your path first to customize your onboarding setup.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Account Sync Status Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit sync reassurance text hint component to the sign-in screen confirming pet retrieval security.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your adopted pets safely to your account profile across reinstalls.

components.text: All created and adopted pets remain linked to your account.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Diagnostic Checklist
candidates.change: Add a photo requirements checklist component to upload_photos screen to guide users on optimal image inputs.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing bad rendering outputs.

upload_photos.hint: Follow photo quality guidelines for best custom pet generation.

components.text: Clear facial view, good lighting, single pet subject

candidates.title: Background Pet Assembly Ready Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and real-time generation tracking on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336s, leading users to leave the desktop app unattended.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: You will receive a notification as soon as your pet is ready to appear on screen.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Desktop Mascot Welcome Layout
candidates.change: Switch the home_intro screen to a full_bleed layout featuring a prominent animated mascot component.
candidates.why: Finish stage completion drops to 64.8%, requiring a visual and immersive onboarding conclusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live!
home_intro.body: Welcome your new pet to your desktop workspace.

candidates.title: Companion Journey Path Selection Headline Refresh
candidates.change: Refresh copy on choose_path screen emphasizing instant adoption vs. custom pet creation flexibility.
candidates.why: 16.2% of users drop off at choose_path with a long mean duration (514s), signaling hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-made companion for instant setup or customize your own from photos.

candidates.title: Split Column Sign-in Account Protection Layout
candidates.change: Change sign_in screen layout to split with a highlighted badge component confirming account data safety.
candidates.why: Account safety concerns and missing pet reports create drop-offs during sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Secure Desktop Pet Account Sign-In
sign_in.body: Connect your account to enable cloud saves, cross-device sync, and pet recovery.
